title: supplier_cost_daily
description: Shared date-keyed supplier cost cache. One row represents one supplier product or variant on one customer travel date.

variantKey.description: Klook package/sku/time key or HBX terminal/direction/tier key. Use default when there is only one cost.

serviceType.description: HBX masterServiceType normalized from supplier availability (PRVT/SHRD/unknown). Non-private or missing semantics are fail-closed for port transfers.

rateKeyRef.description: Private storage reference only. Do not expose raw HBX rateKey.

packageName.description: Supplier package label selected for this travel-date cost.

skuName.description: Supplier SKU/rate label selected for this travel-date cost.

pricingUnitSemantic.description: Conservative unit classification of the selected supplier package/SKU. Legacy or ambiguous rows remain unknown.

pricingUnitEvidence.description: Supplier unit fields and selected labels used for the semantic classification.

semanticChange.description: Comparison with the previous semantic-bearing row for the same source product and travel date.

previousPricingUnitSemantic.description: Prior semantic classification; unknown when the preceding row was legacy or ambiguous.

rawFingerprint.description: Stable hash of the supplier response used for drift detection.
